description: You're conducting an experiment to find your optimal audiobook listening speed. Open /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/audiobook_experiment_raw.xlsx which contains partial data from your speed tests. Read the additional session notes from /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/experiment_notes.txt and integrate them into the spreadsheet. Add calculated columns for Baseline Time, Time Saved, and Efficiency Score using Excel formulas. Create an 'Analysis Summary' sheet with statistics (average comprehension by speed and genre, total time saved). Write data-backed recommendations for optimal speeds for fiction and non-fiction. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
